recreation_brief: 1. Create slide with light gray background (#F0F0F0). 2. Add centered red bold title 'Problems of Linear Regression' at top. 3. Add yellow circle at top-right with black number '7'. 4. Draw white rectangle with blue border spanning most of slide width below title. 5. Inside box, add intro line in dark red: 'Assume the Dataset is linearly separable (suitable to apply Linear regression model)' with 'linearly separable' and 'Linear regression model' underlined. 6. Add blue bold underlined header: 'Linear regression model has FOUR problems:'. 7. Add four bullet lines using ➢ symbol in blue bold: 'Overfitting Problem', 'Matrix Inversion Problem [1] (Singular Matrix)', 'Matrix Inversion Problem [2] (Large Matrix dimension)', 'Different Hyperplanes can solve the problems (Selection of Best Hyperplane)'. 8. Make parenthetical text after each problem red and italic. 9. Ensure all text is left-aligned inside the white box with consistent spacing.
